info.title: On-request Report Management
info.description: The On-request reports API allows you to request reports immediately about your items for faster retrieval. You can request the report, check status on the report availability, and then download the report URL when report is ready. You can also get a list of all reports requested.

get.description:
This API retrieves all report requests that match your query parameters.

You can only view report requests created within the last 30 days.

parameters.name: reportType
parameters.description: Specifies the report type to return. For example, use `ITEM` to retrieve Item reports.

parameters.name: reportVersion
parameters.description: Specifies the version of the report. For example, `v1`.

parameters.name: requestStatus
parameters.description: Filters report requests by status. Valid values are `RECEIVED`, `INPROGRESS`, `READY`, or `ERROR`.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Filters report requests by their creation source. Valid values are `SC` (Seller Center), `API`, or `Scheduler`.

parameters.name: requestSubmissionStartDate
parameters.description: Returns report requests submitted on or after this timestamp. Use ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`).

parameters.name: requestSubmissionEndDate
parameters.description: Returns report requests submitted on or before this timestamp. Use ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`).

parameters.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
parameters.description: The access token retrieved in the Token API call

parameters.name: WM_CONSUMER.CHANNEL.TYPE
parameters.description: A unique ID to track the consumer request by channel. Use the Consumer Channel Type received during onboarding

parameters.name: WM_QOS.CORRELATION_ID
parameters.description: A unique ID which identifies each API call and used to track and debug issues; use a random generated GUID for this ID

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME
parameters.description: Walmart Service Name

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Only supported Media Type : application/json

limit.description: Number of records to be returned. Default is 10.

nextCursor.description: Used for pagination when more than specified limit (or default 10) records are found. Use this param for next API call. Just have to use this value as query param. Need to pass only the cursor value and not the initial API call query params. For e.g. if ['nextCursor'='reportType=ITEM&requestStatus=ERROR&requestSubmissionStartDate=2021-08-20T10:52:59Z&requestSubmissionEndDate=2021-09-14T10:52:59Z&page=2&limit=1'] then subsequent call to will be [marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3/reports/reportRequests?reportType=ITEM&requestStatus=ERROR&requestSubmissionStartDate=2021-08-20T10:52:59Z&requestSubmissionEndDate=2021-09-14T10:52:59Z&page=2&limit=1]. Just have to use nextCursor value instead of query params

post.description:
This endpoints creates a new report request for the specified `reportType` and `reportVersion`.

**Max reporting window:** For `ITEM_PERFORMANCE` v3, the date range between `dataStartTime` and `dataEndTime` must not exceed 2 years (730 days). Exceeding this limit will return a `400` error.

**Row limit:** There is no limit on the number of rows returned in the report.

400.description: Bad request. The request contains invalid or missing parameters.

value.title: Invalid date granularity
value.detail: The value 'YEARLY' is not a valid dateGranularity. Valid values are: `DAILY`, `WEEKLY`, `MONTHLY`, `QUARTERLY`.

maxReportingWindowExceeded.summary: Date range exceeds maximum reporting window

value.title: Reporting window exceeded
value.detail: The date range between `dataStartTime` and `dataEndTime` must not exceed 2 years (730 days) for `ITEM_PERFORMANCE` reports.

value.title: Invalid date range
value.detail: `dataStartTime` must be earlier than or equal to `dataEndTime`.

value.title: Missing required field
value.detail: The fields `dataStartTime`, `dataEndTime`, and `dateGranularity` are required when `reportType=ITEM_PERFORMANCE` and `reportVersion=v3`.

x-maxReportingWindowDays.description: Maximum date range in days between `dataStartTime` and `dataEndTime` for `ITEM_PERFORMANCE` reports. Exceeding this will result in a `400` error.

accessToken.name: WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN
accessToken.description:
Access token required for authenticating API requests.

To obtain a token, call `POST https://marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3/token` with your client ID and client secret using the client credentials grant type. Refer to the [Token API documentation](https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/get-an-access-token) for details.

Pass the resulting token in the `WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN` header with every API request.

authorization.description: Basic authorization header. Base 64 encodes the Client ID and Client Secret retrieved in step two of the integration steps.
